question: Which of the following Articles of the Constitution has a provision that 'all executive actions of the Government of India shall be expressed to be taken in the name of the President'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 77 (1)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Article 77 (1)** of the Indian Constitution mandates that **all executive actions of the Government of India must be expressed to be taken in the name of the President**.
 
• This provision ensures that the President, as the formal head of the executive, is recognized in all governmental actions, even though the real powers are exercised by the Council of Ministers headed by the Prime Minister.
 
• The **President of India** is the nominal executive authority, while the actual execution of policies and decisions lies with the Council of Ministers.
 
• This article is vital for maintaining the parliamentary system of governance, ensuring that all executive actions are performed under a unified authority.
 
• Article 77 further provides guidelines on how orders and instruments made in the President's name are authenticated and ensures their validity in legal proceedings.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 53:** The executive power of the Union is vested in the President and is exercised by him either directly or through officers subordinate to him in accordance with the Constitution.
 
• **Council of Ministers:** Article 74 mandates that the President shall act in accordance with the advice of the Council of Ministers headed by the Prime Minister.
 
• **President's Role:** The President serves as the ceremonial head of the state, while the actual governance is conducted by the Council of Ministers, maintaining the balance of power in a parliamentary system.
 
• **Authentication of Orders:** Article 77 (2) specifies that orders and other instruments made in the President’s name must be authenticated as per the rules framed under this article to ensure their legal validity.
 
• **Article 78:** This article outlines the duties of the Prime Minister, including keeping the President informed of all decisions of the Council of Ministers and matters relating to the administration of the Union.
